title: READ THE SCENE, NOT THE SCRIPT: OUTCOME-AWARE SAFETY FOR LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on CB-Bench to measure 'consequence-blindness' by comparing responses to prompts with mismatched semantic risks (sensitive surface-level keywords) and outcome risks (actual real-world harm) to quantify systematic biases like over-refusals of harmless inputs and vulnerability to semantic camouflage jailbreaks.
